agents.name: Scanner
agents.role: Pulls findings from Fortify, Sonatype and external feeds.

agents.name: Triage
agents.role: Classifies findings into can-fix / needs-review / too-complex.

agents.name: Developer
agents.role: Implements fixes via playbooks; opens merge requests.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.role: Runs regression matrix, raises gates, drafts verdict.

agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.role: Coordinates scrum, enforces policy, schedules ceremonies.
